# Painting Gal

> A website protected by Cloudflare security services with email protection and bot prevention enabled.

Painting Gal uses Cloudflare infrastructure to protect its web presence and user communications. The site requires JavaScript for full functionality and implements email obfuscation to prevent spam.

## Key Topics

- Cloudflare
- Email Protection
- Bot Protection
- JavaScript
- Email Obfuscation
- Web Security

## Security & Protection

- [Email Protection](https://paintinggal.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection): Cloudflare email protection service preventing spam and protecting user email addresses through obfuscation
